title: GateFlow GitHub Protocol schema 2 (hardening)
description: Documentation-only mirror of the schema-2 GitHub-side protocol that the Gate (GitHub Action) enforces: the five comment commands (exact and anchored shapes), the frozen label state machine, workflow markers, and — new in the hardening (docs/plans/v1_hardening_decisions.md) — the Gate-issued RECORD comments (workflow_epoch / approval / feedback_accepted), the Producer source-id anchor, the fail-closed Organization identity rule, and the V1.1 additions (hardening plan): workflow-chain dispatch authorization for every marker transition, epoch record trust (created_by issuer classes + deterministic operation ids + record-first T0), and the gate_transition record. The executable sources of truth are src/gate/* and src/protocol/records.ts.

schema.description: GitHub-side protocol document version. Protocol v2 changes only the /approve command shape; labels, markers and the issue-body schema version remain frozen at 1.

labels.description: The six workflow labels. An issue holds at most one ai:* label at any time.

states.description: Canonical workflow state names, one per label.

transitions.description: The frozen transition table, exactly T0-T6. T2 is the only human-command-triggered approval and is bound to a plan comment id since V1.

commands.description: The five frozen comment commands. Parsing is strict (exact whole-body match after trim, or anchored regex over the trimmed body); substring/prefix matching is forbidden. A body that matches no shape is a normal comment and is silently ignored.

markers.description: The four comment markers. A marker must occupy a line of its own (exact match after trim); a comment with more than one marker occurrence is invalid. Markers are structural hints, NEVER proof of permission.

stateOrNull.description: Transition source state; null means the issue carries no ai:* label (not yet in the workflow).

trigger.const: /ai-plan by Trusted Human, or Producer CREATE with ai:planning

description.const: Issue enters the workflow; /ai-plan requires no ai:* label present.

trigger.const: valid plan-marker comment published by Trusted Human or Trusted Agent

description.const: Plan published. The marker is a structural hint only; publisher identity and the re-read PLANNING state are both required.

V1 approval (protocol section 3.4): the gate validates, in order, that (1) the actor is a Trusted Human, (2) the issue is open and re-reads as REVIEW, (3) the referenced comment exists and belongs to this issue, (4) it carries a valid plan marker (unique, line-owning), (5) it is the CURRENT plan (the last valid plan-marker comment on the issue, chronological by comment id), and (6) the frozen table allows REVIEW -> READY. Any failure is a logged no-op without a reaction. The durable Approval Record is the human's own '/approve <id>' comment; before executor dispatch the Driver independently re-validates current-plan match and plan-unedited-since-approval (docs/architecture-v1.md section 3.3), so a fake ai:ready label flip cannot produce a valid dispatch.

trigger.const: valid execution-tracker-marker comment published by Trusted Human or Trusted Agent
tracker comment edited to the machine value '**Status:** Blocked'

description.const: Deterministically parsed from the tracker Status field; never guessed.

trigger.const: tracker comment edited to the machine value '**Status:** In Progress'

description.const: Deterministically parsed from the tracker Status field; never guessed.

trigger.const: valid completion-report-marker comment published by Trusted Human or Trusted Agent

description.const: Completion goes exclusively through the completion-report marker; tracker Status 'Completed' never transitions. DONE is terminal.

match.description: exact: whole comment equals the command after trim. anchored: the given regex must match the entire trimmed body ('.' never crosses newlines).

args.description: Parsed argument shape; null for parameterless commands.

breakingChange.description: Present when V1 changed the command shape.

precondition.const: issue carries no ai:* label (outside the workflow)

effect.const: T0: add ai:planning; react +1 on acceptance

planCommentId.description: Id of the plan comment being approved: a GitHub issue-comment id in decimal digits (positive integer).

precondition.const: issue is open and re-reads as REVIEW, and the referenced comment passes every V1 validation of docs/protocol.md section 3.4 (exists on this issue; valid plan marker; current plan)

effect.const: T2: add ai:ready then remove ai:review (add-then-remove); react +1 on acceptance. A failing validation is a logged no-op WITHOUT any reaction; a bare '/approve' is no longer a command at all and is ignored as a normal comment.

breakingChange.const: V1 (protocol v2): the parameterless '/approve' command was removed; approval is bound to a plan comment id.

effect.const: No state migration: the two arguments are forwarded verbatim to the Consumer as untrusted data; react +1 on acceptance

text.description: Free text after the command word, preserved verbatim as untrusted data.

effect.const: No state migration: the free text is forwarded verbatim to the Consumer as untrusted data; react +1 on acceptance

precondition.const: issue carries at least one ai:* label (any state, including BLOCKED and terminal DONE)

effect.const: Remove ALL ai:* labels; the issue is NOT closed; react +1 on acceptance

value.description: Exact marker string; must occupy a line of its own (exact match after trim). Unchanged from V0 (:v1 suffix frozen).

publisher.description: Who may publish marker comments that trigger transitions; unknown actors' markers are plain text.

triggers.description: Transition triggered by a valid marker comment, or 'none' when the marker never transitions.

schemaVersion.description: GitHub protocol schema version, 2 since the hardening.

login.description: GitHub login shape (used for identities inside records).

epochString.description: wf_ + 12 lowercase base36 chars, CSPRNG-generated by a trusted runtime.

recordEnvelope.description: A Gate-issued record comment: the record marker line owning its line, a blank line, then a fenced ```json block whose object carries EXACTLY the frozen field set (unknown/missing keys reject the record). Record markers are NOT workflow markers and never trigger transitions. Authorization classes: workflow_epoch is issued by the Gate ('gate') or an explicit Bootstrap Driver ('driver_bootstrap'); approval, feedback_accepted and gate_transition are Gate-ONLY. V1.1 adds gate_transition (Phase 4). Comment-borne records are auditable and revocation-safe (protected identity + fail-closed validation) but NOT strongly tamper-proof.

epochRecord.description: workflow_epoch record — names ONE formal workflow round of an issue. V1.1 Phase 3: operation_id is DETERMINISTIC — gate T0: epoch:<repository_id>:<issue_number>:c<command_comment_id>; driver bootstrap: epoch:<repository_id>:<issue_number>:bootstrap. The random epoch VALUE is never part of the id, so a redelivered /ai-plan re-derives the same operation id and ADOPTS the existing record (no second epoch); conflicting epochs under one operation id FAIL CLOSED. Current epoch = the surviving record with the highest comment id. V1.1 ordering: the record is written BEFORE the ai:planning label (record-first: no epoch -> no PLANNING).

created_by.description: V1.1 Phase 2 (Epoch Record Trust): WHO issued this epoch. 'gate' = the Gate itself (T0 /ai-plan; the record comment must be authored by a Gate identity). 'driver_bootstrap' = an explicit Bootstrap Driver identity (Producer-submitted planning issues; authored by a configured bootstrap-driver login). The issuer class is re-validated on every read; forged epochs fail closed.

approvalRecord.description: approval record — the durable authorization fact behind T2, written AND content-verified BEFORE the ai:ready label swap. operation_id: approval:<repository_id>:<issue_number>:<workflow_epoch>:p<plan_comment_id>. plan_sha256 is the FROZEN canonicalization of the approved Plan comment body (src/protocol/plan.ts). Reuse-or-conflict: an existing record with the same operation id and identical content is reused (crash recovery); divergent content FAILS CLOSED (an edited plan stays burned). The Driver independently re-validates: author in gate_logins, repo/issue/epoch/plan binding, recomputed hash equality, and the anchored /approve command comment.

feedbackRecord.description: feedback_accepted record — the Gate accepted one /choose or /change after identity, format and REVIEW preconditions. The ONLY input to Consumer revisions (1 + count in the current epoch, still anchored to an existing trusted-human command comment). operation_id: feedback:<repository_id>:<issue_number>:<workflow_epoch>:<feedback_comment_id>; event_id: fe<feedback_comment_id>. Rejected, duplicated, foreign-epoch and plain-text comments never produce one.

sourceIdAnchor.description: The `<!-- gateflow:source-id: <operation_id> -->` HTML comment embedded in Producer-submitted issue bodies (operation id `submit:<submission_id>`). Submit reconciliation adopts an existing issue by this anchor after unknown API outcomes instead of re-POSTing; titles are never used for dedup.

gateTransitionRecord.description: V1.1 Phase 4: gate_transition record — the durable audit fact that the Gate accepted a SPECIFIC source object (source_comment_id: the command or marker comment) and performed the SPECIFIC label migration (transition T1-T6, from_label, to_label), bound to the workflow_epoch and (when present) the dispatch_id. Published BEFORE the label swap (record-first, fail closed); idempotent by operation id transition:<repository_id>:<issue_number>:<workflow_epoch>:<transition>:<source_comment_id>. A Driver receipt's 'accepted' MUST bind to this record (epoch + dispatch + transition + source comment) — a bare label observation never suffices (V1.1 Phase 5). Gate-issued ONLY.
